g.text: MB vs MF: from noiseless to noisy
Mean real environment steps over all runs, paired with solve rate.
3 noiseless seeds / 2 noisy seeds per arm. MB won every level in every selected run.
Noiseless: MB without added uncertainty features. Noisy: latest completed MB with features; historical MF.
Versions and seed counts differ; connecting lines are descriptive. * Boil also changes from 2 test jugs to 1.
Balloons uses the original non-hatch distribution. Low all-run effort may reflect early failure. Polled 10 Sep 2026.
